title: The essay editor needs word and character counts for funding bids (2026-10-29)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
The srs-web essay editor needs to provide word and character counts. 

One of the initial purposes for the essay is to assist in writing carefully researched funding bids. These will always need specific word or character counts. 

We need ot show counts per paragraph and totals per essay. 
We should only include paragraphs in the main body. We should include hidden paragraphs. 

Where paragraphs are nested, we should show subtotals. 

Numbers can be small, with a hover to make them easier.
